function.name: fx_graph_build_network
function.description: [FX MCP/graph] Build a whole node network atomically, with upfront validation.

nodes.description: Node specs, each a dict: type (str, required): node type name (unversioned ok). name (str): node name, referenceable by later specs. parms (dict): parameter values; lists set whole parm tuples. inputs (list): wiring. Entries are either a source string (wired positionally) or {"index", "source", "source_output"}. Sources resolve to spec node names first, then children of parent, then absolute paths. flags (dict): display/render/bypass/template booleans. color (list[3]) and comment (str): network annotations.

dry_run.description: Validate only; never mutates the scene.

layout.description: Lay out the parent network afterwards (respects the FXHOUDINIMCP_AUTO_LAYOUT toggle).

step.description: Frame increment. 1.0 for a sequential solver -- skipping frames gives a solver a discontinuous time step and invalid results.

attribs.description: Point attributes to aggregate per frame (min/max/mean/sum).

volumes.description: Also report per-volume name, resolution and value range.
